verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a Cloud REST API reference (pulumi-docs-50). Its `pulumi api` CLI command lets users call any Pulumi Cloud REST endpoint (pulumi-docs-49, pulumi-docs-44), which gives a way to run API calls. However, nothing shows the reference itself is interactive or embeds runnable examples, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths (pulumi-probe-3). Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
